verdict.text: Pakistan pledges a 15% reduction by 2030 against 2030 business-as-usual (unconditional), and 50% conditional on international support. The registry's current submission for this Party is NDC 3.0, filed 2025-09-24. It was read and refused, so the figure above comes from the First NDC (2021). The document's condition, in its own words: "Fg.1.1: Voluntary and Conditional Reduction of 50% below its projected BAU emissions by 2030 HIGH PRIORITY ACTIONS The GoP attaches High Priority to reduce future GHG emissions from the following four sectoral initiatives which are conditional to the availability of international financial and technical resources: MITIGATION: 1." 50 observed values are loaded from DS-02 (11), DS-35 (35), DS-40 (4). For 2024 the sources disagree: DS-02 482 MtCO₂e, DS-35 473.8 MtCO₂e. They are on different inventory scopes and the engine does not reconcile them. No implementation gap is reported: the pledge is 15% below a business-as-usual projection for 2030. That projection is not in any source loaded here, so the percentage cannot be turned into a tonnage and the trend cannot be judged against it. It submitted BTR1. 4 of 8 components have been confirmed in the document; the rest are unparsed, which is not a finding against the country. ND-GAIN scores it 39.3 for 2024. In the first NDC round, WRI's CAIT assessment recorded: Up to 20% reduction in GHG emissions by 2030 compared to the projected GHG emissions It was classed conditional. That is a 2016 assessment of an earlier submission, not the target above. Projected warming for 2080-2099 against 1995-2014 ranges from +1.46°C under SSP1-2.6 to +5.03°C under SSP5-8.5. These are model runs, not observations.
